beats.caption: Clarcam, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Clarcam and its eighteen families, from 1873 to 1926.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records four baptisms at Clarcam between 1873 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 77, 54 and 54 people in Clarcam, in 18, 15 and 16 households. Heads of household included Morrow, Bustard and Kelly.
Here are the families of Clarcam, from 1873 to 1926. First, the Bustard and Morrow families.
The Bustard family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.
Clarcam had three Bustard households in 1901, headed by Charles, John and Margaret.
Clarcam had four Bustard households in 1911, headed by Thomas, Charles, John and William.
Clarcam had five Bustard households in 1926, headed by Hamilton, Ben, William, Thomas and Isabella.
The Morrow family appear in the records from 1901 to 1926.
Clarcam had four Morrow households in 1901, headed by Thomas, John, Francis and Richard.
Clarcam had four Morrow households in 1911, headed by Thomas, Susan, Francis and William.
Clarcam had four Morrow households in 1926, headed by Thomas, Susan, Francis and William.
